name: DOH-5-hemiFLY
summary: DOH-5-hemiFLY, or DMA-hemiFly-5, also known as semi-fly (SF), is a serotonin receptor modulator and putative psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, DOx, and benzofuran families related to 2,5-dimethoxyamphetamine (2,5-DMA; DOH). It is a cyclized derivative of 2,5-DMA related to the FLY psychedelics.
